response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements of this role. C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle work (only MySQL/MongoDB and generic SQL), and no fixed income, derivatives, investment banking, or capital markets domain exposure — the closest adjacency is a fintech/investment platform role at RIDE Capital using Node/TypeScript. Strengths in testing culture, CI/CD, and communication are genuine but secondary to the disqualifying gaps.
strengths: Deep, broad senior-level engineering experience across web, embedded, and low-latency systems
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development, plus open-source test tooling
Excellent communication evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and course authoring; fluent English
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience (2014–2015), versus the required 5–10 years
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking/capital markets domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle experience and no Windows-platform development focus
